title: A ledger-only push during ci keeps the tested build off npm and out of `built`
foundBy: session agent, while tracing which commit a publish images run is listed under
details: The `npm` workflow publishes only while the commit `ci` tested is still main's head. A ledger-only push that lands during `ci` therefore keeps a good build off npm, where it exists only as images. Its `publish images` run is also listed under the ledger commit, so the status file never names the build either. A sibling pinning the last build then waits for the next code push.
